# Call Packages 

```{r library_packages}
library(rnassqs)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)


```
# Set API Key 

```{r}


# Set your API key
nassqs_auth(key = "9E6A687A-B7F5-3950-B4BA-8511C501D06B")


```

# Query all the crops for North Carolina by changing the year

```{r}
# Define year variable
year_choice <- "2000"

# Define parameters
params <- list(
  year = year_choice,
  state_alpha = "NC",
  agg_level_desc = "COUNTY",
  statisticcat_desc = "PRODUCTION"
)

# Make the query
nc_crops_data <- nassqs(params)

# Clean up the data for clarity
nc_crops_clean <- nc_crops_data |>
  select(
    year,
    state_name,
    county_name,
    commodity_desc,
    statisticcat_desc,
    unit_desc,
    Value
  ) |>
  arrange(county_name, commodity_desc)

# View the data
print(nc_crops_clean)

# Save to CSV
output_filename <- paste0("NC_Crops_", year_choice, ".csv")
write_csv(nc_crops_clean, output_filename)

cat("Data saved to '", output_filename, "'\n", sep = "")
```
# Gather a list of Different Commodities

```{r commoditieslist}
unique_commodities <- unique(nc_crops_clean$commodity_desc)
print(unique_commodities)
```

# Gather a list of Different Units of Measurement
```{r statisticslist}
unique_statistics <- unique(nc_crops_clean$statisticcat_desc)
print(unique_statistics)

```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)

# Step 1: Define your folder path and file names
folder_path <- ""  # Make sure to set your correct path here!

file_names <- c(
  "NC_Crops_1996_clean.csv",
  "NC_Crops_1997_clean.csv",
  "NC_Crops_1998_clean.csv",
  "NC_Crops_1999_clean.csv",
  "NC_Crops_2000_clean.csv"
)

# Step 2: Combine all CSVs
combined_data <- file_names %>%
  paste0(folder_path, .) %>%                 # Build full paths
  lapply(read_csv) %>%                       # Read all CSVs into list of dataframes
  bind_rows() %>%                            # Combine into a single dataframe
  mutate(county_name = str_to_title(county_name))  # Standardize county names to Title Case

# Step 3: Save the combined clean data
write_csv(combined_data, paste0(folder_path, "NC_Crops_Combined_1996_2000.csv"))
```

# Join Combined Dataframe to NC Counties geojson

```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)

# Read cleaned combined CSV
combined_data <- read_csv("NC_Crops_Combined_1996_2000.csv")

# Read GeoJSON
nc_counties <- st_read("ncCounties.geojson")

# Perform the spatial join
nc_counties_joined <- nc_counties %>%
  left_join(combined_data, by = c("NAME" = "county_name"))

# Save the new GeoJSON (with all data merged!)
st_write(nc_counties_joined, "NC_Counties_Crop_Production_1996_2000.geojson")

```
